purpose: Select candidate 49 as one economically distinct Level-1 minute mechanism while moving all predictive evaluation to a post-registration future-only track.

future_only_policy.earliest_eligible_signal_session: the first accepted local provider-calendar session on or after 2026-07-27

selected_candidate.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m
formula_steps: Require the exact immutable 240-position continuous-session grid for a stock-day already present in the joint-clean base.
Require every close to be finite and strictly positive and every volume and amount to be finite and nonnegative.
Reject the whole stock-day when exactly one of volume or amount is zero at any position; retain a joint zero as an inactive bar.
At each position t compute cumulative_volume_t and cumulative_amount_t from positions 1 through t.
A position has a cumulative VWAP only when both cumulative sums are finite and strictly positive; cumulative_vwap_t=cumulative_amount_t/cumulative_volume_t.
For every valid cumulative-VWAP position compute the exact sign of log(close_t/cumulative_vwap_t).
Drop exact-zero deviation signs only from the crossing sequence; do not fill, jitter, round, or assign them to either side.
Require at least two nonzero deviation signs and divide the count of adjacent sign changes by the number of adjacent nonzero-sign pairs.
Only a 1e-12 floating-point endpoint canonicalization to [0,1] is allowed.
selected_candidate.formula: mean(1[sign(log(close_t/cumulative_vwap_t)) changes between adjacent nonzero deviation signs]) over the exact 240-position continuous-session path
selected_candidate.hypothesis: Frequent price crossings around the stock's own running traded-value anchor indicate continuous two-sided price discovery instead of a one-way temporary displacement; the higher direction is preregistered as a liquidity-resilience signal for the next-open through third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.economic_distinction: The factor measures pathwise alternation around a causal cumulative traded-value anchor. It is not determined by terminal location, return magnitude, return sign share, unchanged-minute share, amount timing, amount-profile shape, bar-level close-to-VWAP pressure, market synchronization, fundamentals, events, or a daily price.

overlap_reaudit.late_vwap_to_day_vwap_30m: Uses a fixed late-window VWAP relative to the full-day VWAP; the candidate counts the order of crossings around a causal running VWAP over all 240 positions.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_bar_vwap_close_pressure_240m: Averages signed log close versus each bar's own amount/volume VWAP with amount weights; the candidate uses cumulative amount and volume and discards deviation magnitude after its exact sign.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_terminal_close_location_240m: Uses only the terminal close relative to the day's close range; the candidate can differ for paths with the same terminal close and range.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_return_sign_run_imbalance_238p: Counts consecutive raw-return sign pairs; the candidate signs deviations from a path-dependent cumulative VWAP anchor rather than adjacent returns.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_price_update_share_238m: Counts whether adjacent closes differ; the candidate requires alternation around a causal value anchor and can be zero despite every close updating.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m: Uses amount timing alone; holding close fixed is necessary for the candidate, while holding all amount values fixed does not determine its crossing sequence.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_amount_volatility_coupling_238p: Correlates absolute return with destination amount; the candidate uses neither return magnitude nor a correlation.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_market_idiosyncratic_share_238m: Compares stock returns with a leave-one-out market return; the candidate is single-stock and uses no peer benchmark.
overlap_reaudit.intraday_market_amount_profile_synchroni: Compares normalized amount profiles across stocks and reads no price; the candidate uses one stock's close, cumulative amount, and cumulative volume with no cross-stock benchmark.
overlap_reaudit.all_other_terminal_minute_factors: They measure volatility, semivariance, entropy, skewness, diffusive variation, amount concentration/persistence/direction, opening-auction participation, afternoon efficiency/recovery, or market synchronization rather than causal cumulative-VWAP crossing order.
overlap_reaudit.daily_fundamental_event_or_regime_factor: Those mechanisms use daily, accounting, event, or shared market-state observables and cannot reconstruct this 240-position within-stock sequence.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: low_crossing_or_trend_persistence_direction
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: This is the inversion of the frozen higher resilience direction.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: crossing_count_or_signed_crossing_imbalance
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Changing the denominator or separating upward and downward crossings adds post-result degrees of freedom.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: bar_vwap_daily_vwap_or_future_vwap_anchor
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Those are different or non-causal anchors and overlap terminal VWAP mechanisms.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: epsilon_band_rounding_or_zero_sign_carry
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Any tolerance band, price rounding, jitter, or zero-sign fill would create a tunable crossing definition.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: morning_afternoon_late_or_auction_windows
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Window selection and inclusion of the ambiguous 09:30 row are prohibited.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: amount_only_volume_only_equal_weight_or_typical_price_vwap
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: The running traded-value anchor is frozen to cumulative CNY amount divided by cumulative shares and raw close.

alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.name: threshold_subset_filter_weight_or_combination
alternatives_rejected_before_value_obser.reason: Liquidity, volatility, event, year, board, industry, market-state, magnitude, and crossing-count filters or combinations are prohibited.

decision: Proceed only to a separately hash-bound no-return preregistration, then build candidate values and run ordered historical coverage, capacity, and twenty-four-factor uniqueness without historical prices or forward returns.
